Seedance 2.5 Prompt
30 seconds. 16:9. Photoreal live-action spectacle. Bright daytime in a fictional American theme park. Powerful physical action, mechanical transformation, large-scale attraction destruction.

CAMERA AND ACTION
Action-movie camerawork continues every second throughout the entire video.
Use strong foreground-to-background depth, diagonal compositions, decisive changes in camera height, near-lens debris and fast parallax. Favor a moving 24–28mm perspective for action; reserve tighter lenses for the hero's eyes and weapon contact. Keep anatomy undistorted.
Camera movement follows an action: accelerate with a launch, descend with a falling body, react briefly to an impact, then recover immediately. Combine low pursuit, threatening upward angles, moving over-the-shoulder views and brief elevated views.
Avoid a procession of centered, eye-level full-body shots. Do not make a new cut merely because a new second begins. The transformation is one continuous moving shot; the landing and rescue form another continuous shot. No arbitrary orbiting, floating showcase poses or constant slow motion.
Keep important contacts readable. Show anticipation, contact and recoil. Use only a brief speed ramp during airborne assembly and the finishing cut.

REFERENCE IDENTITIES
Image 1: ONE unarmored hero. Preserve the dark-skinned man's face, black braided hair, black pinstripe suit, sunglasses, metal gauntlets and boots.
Image 2: the SAME hero inside the exact red, bone-beige and black cyber-samurai armor, closed mask, red lenses and back-mounted katana scabbard. Approximately 2.1 meters tall, never a giant robot.
Image 3: the numerous ordinary clown soldiers. Preserve their jester caps, mechanical clown faces and spiked black/red armor. Their weapons are Gatling guns, clearly curved-blade scythes and grenades.
Image 4: ONE boss king. Preserve his gold crown, white clown face, black/gold armor, red details and black-and-white checkerboard cape in EVERY boss shot. He never wears a soldier's jester cap. His weapons are the execution greatsword and reference energy cannon.
Image 5: ONE black-and-gold hypercar. Preserve its recognizable engine, wheels and panels until those same components become the hero's armor.
Image 6: the American theme park: horned skull main gate, red roller coaster, carousel, Ferris wheel, mirror house and stalls. Use clear daylight rather than sunset.

Only the assigned weapons appear. The hero attacks with discrete RED PALM ENERGY BOLTS, punches and his katana. Palm bolts are separate projectiles with visible gaps, not continuous laser beams. The hero never carries a staff, scythe or gun.
The boss cannon fires a WHITE-GOLD beam. His cannon remains physically separate from his sword; it swings forward on an articulated back bracket rather than materializing or changing from a sword.
Only the ordinary soldiers appear in groups. Never duplicate the hero or boss. All enemy bodies contain mechanical parts; damage reveals gears, pistons, cables and sparks, never blood or flesh.
Reference sheets define appearance only. Do not show their panels, labels or weapon inventories.

RESCUE AND SPATIAL CONTINUITY
The featured family consists of an Indian father in an olive-green casual shirt and dark jeans, and his young daughter in a pale pink dress. Preserve their identities and clothes. They are cornered at one ticket kiosk.
At the rescue, the attacker is on screen right, the family is behind the hero on screen left, and the hero lands between them. The family's escape route stays behind the hero, away from the enemy's flight path.
For the boss duel, establish the hero on screen left and the king on screen right, facing each other, with the skull gate behind the king. Keep the camera on one side of this axis until the finishing pass. Establish a visible gap before the cannon fires. Its muzzle must point directly at the hero across that gap.

CAR-TO-ARMOR TRANSFORMATION
From 07–12, use ONE continuous tracking shot. Keep the hero's body and the disassembling car or its remaining modules visible together. Show parts leaving their source, traveling through space, folding and locking onto him.
The hero pushes off the driver's door sill with bent knees, drives one knee forward and follows a single forward ballistic arc. His body actively tucks, rotates toward the attacker and prepares to land. Never suspend him upright or fly him horizontally with rigid, dangling limbs.
The engine assembly locks onto his back. Wheel assemblies segment and fold around leg joints and shoulder mounts. Doors, fenders and hood split into overlapping chest, arm and leg armor; black/gold outer surfaces rotate inward to reveal the final red and bone-beige surfaces.
Use only a few readable major modules, with visible hinges and mechanical connections. Smaller pieces follow those modules. Do not substitute already-finished armor between cuts or let pieces grow out of his skin.
As the last panels close, the entire vehicle has become the fitted Image 2 suit. No spare car remains. His discarded sunglasses never reappear. The mask closes last while he is already descending toward the rescue.

SECOND-BY-SECOND CHOREOGRAPHY

00–01
Camera 25 cm above the pavement at a clown gunner's rear quarter. His Gatling fires diagonally into the carousel in the background; a shattered carousel horse hurtles close past the lens. Begin with action already happening.

01–02
Continue a fast lateral move through broken railings and flying debris, revealing a broad formation of clowns firing across the attraction plaza. Screaming visitors rush across the near foreground, creating strong parallax.

02–03
Hard cut beneath the roller-coaster track. A grenade thrown by a visible clown strikes a support; the camera snaps upward with the blast as red rails twist and empty ride cars fall into the evacuated enclosure.

03–04
Child-height backward movement beside the Indian daughter. Her father pulls her behind him against the ticket kiosk. A clown's unmistakable crescent scythe enters the foreground, enclosing the family in the composition.

04–05
A ground-skimming pursuit camera races backward ahead of Image 5 as it bursts through the skull entrance. Broken turnstile pieces sweep close to the lens; the car rapidly fills the frame.

05–06
Cut to a low rear three-quarter chase. The car drifts across the plaza, sweeping mechanical clowns sideways into empty barriers, then straightens toward the threatened family. Maintain the car's left-to-right momentum.

06–07
Tight moving interior angle: Image 1 pulls off his sunglasses and drops them into the car; his eyes glow red. Cut on his eyeline to the scythe lifting over the father and daughter. This is one brief imminent-danger moment.

07–08
BEGIN THE UNBROKEN TRANSFORMATION SHOT. Low front-side tracking shows the driver's door opening and the hero pushing explosively from its sill. Behind him the car pitches upward and separates into a few large, identifiable modules.

08–09
The camera accelerates alongside their forward arc and rises to hip height. The engine module detaches visibly from the chassis, closes the gap to his back and locks onto him. The remaining car structure stays visible beside him.

09–10
Continue a limited sweep toward his front three-quarter angle while descending slightly. Wheel segments fold around his bent legs and shoulder joints; doors and fenders advance from behind. Show the modules traveling and making contact, not merely the resulting armor.

10–11
The same moving camera climbs toward chest height. Body panels hinge around his torso and arms, exposing red and bone-beige surfaces. The katana scabbard locks onto his back. The last recognizable car framework folds into the suit; no intact vehicle remains.

11–12
Still in the same shot, the camera descends with him and widens enough to include the landing space. The mask snaps shut; he drives both boots downward and bends his knees in preparation. Reveal the attacker, raised scythe and family ahead before contact.

12–13
CUT ON DOWNWARD MOTION to a low three-quarter side view containing hero, attacker and family. Both soles hit the pavement; ankles, knees and hips visibly compress. Without holding a pose, his LEFT hand catches the metal scythe shaft just below its clearly visible curved blade. The clown still grips the same shaft with both hands. The blade stops short of the family; dust bursts low around the planted boots.

13–14
CONTINUE THE SAME SHOT. The hero twists the captured shaft outward, delivers one powerful RIGHT punch and releases the shaft as the clown flies away with its weapon. The camera whips with it into an empty kiosk on the opposite side of the lane, where its body bursts into gears and scrap. The father carries his daughter away behind the hero.

14–15
Exactly one second of crowd escape. A moving waist-height camera runs beside visitors fleeing in front of the Ferris wheel. The same father and daughter pass through the foreground; billowing dust follows behind them.

15–16
Low front three-quarter pursuit: the hero drives diagonally through the lane, firing distinct red palm bolts. Each pulse leaves his hand, crosses visible space and strikes a charging mechanical clown.

16–17
Reverse over a soldier's shoulder. A bolt strikes the foreground soldier; the camera tracks its violent recoil through an empty food stall, keeping the advancing hero visible deeper in the frame.

17–18
Camera slides close to the pavement beside the hero's knee-slide. Gatling rounds rake the ground just behind his moving boots. He pivots his shoulders and shoots the gunner apart with two separate palm bursts.

18–19
Brief elevated oblique view establishes the hero, grenade-throwing soldiers and mirror house. He intercepts a thrown grenade above the enemy formation; the blast throws their machine bodies backward and bursts the mirror-house windows.

19–20
A scythe sweeps close across the lens, motivating a sharp pan to the hero sidestepping its path. His palm blast strikes the attacker's chest. Follow the recoil as armor and gears scatter through the shattered glass.

20–21
A fast rising wide shot follows the last enemy bodies crashing into abandoned attractions. Their grenades trigger a chain of explosions across stalls and ride machinery. Burning wreckage fills the foreground; the skull gate remains standing behind it.

21–22
Aggressive low-angle push beneath an intact coaster rail beside the skull gate. Reveal the ONE crowned Image 4 king with his execution sword and heavy checkerboard cape. Hold the crown and distinctive face clearly in the composition.

22–23
Over the hero's shoulder, the king leaps down with his greatsword raised. The hero draws his katana as the camera drops with the descending enemy. The king's body accelerates downward; no hovering or prolonged airborne pose.

23–24
Low moving two-shot: the king's descending greatsword meets the hero's raised katana. Show the actual crossing blades and violent contact. The impact drives the hero's boots through the paving; both bodies recoil under the force.

24–25
A short lateral track follows the hero redirecting the heavy blade. The king's armored shoulder-check sends him skidding six meters backward in a shower of sparks. They remain facing each other, hero left and king right. The king swings his separate cannon forward on its bracket.

25–26
Oblique wide view keeps BOTH opponents and the gap visible. The king aims directly at the hero and fires right-to-left. Trace the beam from its visible muzzle through empty space toward the hero. The hero is never behind the king, and the king never fires away from him.

26–27
Move closer along the hero's front three-quarter side. He presents the katana's cutting edge to the incoming beam. Show the white-gold core contacting the blade FIRST and then dividing into two streams around him. He drives forward between those streams toward the king; the split energy tears into deserted attractions on both sides.

27–28
A fast oblique tracking shot carries the hero through the king's position. Use one brief slow-motion accent on a SINGLE diagonal katana cut. The blade visibly passes through the mechanical torso; two armored sections separate with momentum, exposed gears and sparks. The upper section topples, the lower section buckles. The hero finishes his pass in the foreground.

28–29
CONTINUE THE FINISHING SHOT; keep the king's separated remains visible behind the hero. Those same remains erupt into a large fireball and a dense spray of mechanical scrap. The blast hits the damaged skull supports and the enormous skull breaks loose. Do not replace the king's destruction with an unrelated background explosion.

29–30
The camera settles into a low frontal three-quarter push toward the hero. Without looking back, he slides his katana into its back-mounted scabbard and finishes facing forward. The skull crashes down behind him, triggering a broad wave of collapsing gate masonry, ride structures and rolling fire. End on the hero's strong silhouette amid an unmistakably devastated daytime park.

AUDIO
Include an original heavy industrial action BGM with deep bass and driving percussion. Build sharply through the car entrance and assembly. Synchronize accents with module locks, boot impact, blade contact and the finishing strike.
Briefly reduce the music during the decisive blade contact, then hit hard with the boss explosion. Lower the music again for the final sheath click.
Layer engine roar, tire squeal, moving metal, servo locks, heavy foot impacts, gunfire, separate energy-bolt pulses, scythe strain, sword collisions, glass, crowd screams and large structural collapses. No dialogue or narration.

CONSTRAINTS
No blood, flesh, organs or graphic civilian injuries. Destroyed clowns become mechanical scrap; the family escapes unharmed.
No staff in the hero's hands. No sunglasses after they are discarded. No soldier's hat on the king. No duplicate hero, spare car, instant weapon replacement or changing family identities.
No static airborne mannequin poses, floating landings, skipped foot contact, decorative landing poses, beam splitting before blade contact or disappearing boss remains.
No subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, added logos, watermarks or reference-sheet labels. Preserve existing costume markings.
Keep daylight, reference identities, clear geography and the cause-and-effect chain of every major impact.

Seedance 2.5 提示词
30 秒。16:9。照片级真人实拍奇观。虚构美国主题公园中的明亮白天。强力肢体动作、机械变形、大规模游乐设施破坏。

摄影机与动作
全片每一秒都持续保持动作片式的摄影。
运用强前景到背景的纵深、斜线构图、果断的机位高度变化、近镜头碎屑与快速视差。动作部分优先使用移动中的 24–28mm 视角；更紧的镜头只用于主角的眼睛和武器接触。保持人体解剖结构不变形。
摄影机运动跟随动作：随弹射加速，随坠落的身体下降，对撞击做出短暂反应，随即立刻恢复。综合运用低位追击、具有压迫感的仰角、移动中的越肩视角与短暂的俯视视角。
避免连续出现居中、平视的全身镜头。不要仅仅因为进入新的一秒就切换镜头。变形是一镜到底的连续运动镜头；落地与救援构成另一个连续镜头。不要无意义的环绕、漂浮的展示姿态或持续的慢动作。
保持重要接触点清晰可读。展现预备、接触与反作用。只在凌空组装阶段和最终斩击时使用短暂的升格/降格变速。

参考身份
Image 1：一位未着甲的主角。保持该深色皮肤男性的面容、黑色编发、黑色细条纹西装、太阳镜、金属护手与靴子。
Image 2：同一位主角，穿着完全一致的红色、骨米色与黑色的赛博武士装甲，面罩闭合，红色镜片，背-mounted（背负）武士刀鞘。身高约 2.1 米，绝不是巨型机器人。
Image 3：众多普通小丑士兵。保持他们的丑角帽、机械小丑面孔以及带刺的黑/红装甲。他们的武器为加特林机枪、明显带有弧形刀刃的镰刀和手榴弹。

### LAYOUT
Divide the canvas into two perfectly equal horizontal sections (50/50):
- Top: Original photograph.
- Bottom: Artistic impasto oil painting interpretation.

Both sections must connect directly with a clean horizontal boundary, without gaps, gradients, or overlapping.

### TOP SECTION — PHOTOGRAPHY
Preserve the original subject's identity, quantity, pose, proportions, silhouette, details, composition, perspective, lighting, and natural colors. Apply only subtle premium color grading. Do not redraw, distort, duplicate, reposition, or alter the subject. No text or decorations.

### BOTTOM SECTION — ARTISTIC INTERPRETATION
Reimagine the same subject as a sculptural impasto oil painting micro-landscape. Use thick layered paint, palette-knife textures, handcrafted forms, raised edges, and expressive brushstrokes.

Keep the subject recognizable, centrally or slightly off-center, surrounded by generous warm-white negative space. Introduce a single color band inspired by the original photograph, transformed into a ground, water, pathway, or abstract landscape element.

### COLORS & TEXTURES
Extract a harmonious, limited color palette from the original photograph. Preserve the subject's natural color character while adding subtle brightness and luminosity. Use rich paint textures selectively, with refined subject details and delicate matte paper texture.

### TYPOGRAPHY
Add a short, elegant English title and one small supporting line within the lower section's negative space. Use thin, minimal typography. Generate text based on the actual subject or mood. Avoid invented dates, locations, logos, signatures, and unnecessary annotations.

### AESTHETIC
Quiet, minimal, sophisticated, and editorial. Create a collectible fine-art publication aesthetic through negative space, sculptural depth, material textures, and balanced composition.

### AVOID
Photo collages, altered subjects, unrelated scenes, illustrated photography, extra title bars, clutter, excessive decorations, incorrect text, watermarks, cartoon styles, neon colors, oversaturation, muddy tones, plastic-looking 3D, and cheap CGI.

Tips to remember
- Keep text short. One headline is easier than a full paragraph
- Put the exact words in quotes
- Spell names and rare words letter by letter
- Say "no other text" or the model may add its own
- Small text needs Quality [Medium] or [High]
- One wrong letter? Do an edit: "change only the word X to Y, keep everything else the same". Do not start over

I add text in my editor at the end.

如何制作看起来不像 AI 的 AI UGC 创作者照片

我经过 7 轮测试生成…

how to make ai ugc creator photos that don't look ai

i generated ~150 fake creators over 7 rounds of testing. by round 5 i couldn't spot them at phone size. round 7 is the one i'd actually use

the play: paused video frame -> the room's own light > real skin -> phone video ruin pass

first steps

- go to https://t.co/tTladQiKyi and open a new chat (gpt image is built in)

- don't ask for "a photo". ask for "a paused frame from a vertical phone video someone recorded for their story"

- set the framing: front camera at arm's length, or phone propped about a metre away. pick one per shot

- eyes on the screen just below the lens, not into it. that's how people actually look at a front camera

- describe the room's own mixed light: "grey window daylight plus a warm ceiling light". no golden hour, no "bright and airy"

- put the room in: unmade bed, a charger cable, a mug, a laundry basket. rentals, not pinterest

- describe the skin you want, not what to avoid: visible pores, peach fuzz, a few marks, slight shine on the forehead and nose

- add the small stuff: off-white teeth, frizzy flyaways, little to no makeup

- change the expression and camera every shot. in round 1, 7 out of 10 had the same closed-mouth smirk

the ruin pass

- rounds 1 to 5: shrink to 720p and back up, a touch of blur and sharpening, light grain, save as jpg

- round 7 (better): turn the image into a 1 second video at 720p, then grab a frame. real video compression smears the skin and blocks the shadows the way a paused tiktok does. capcut works for this: export 1 s at 720p, screenshot

the catch

- a clean image is still too clean. the ruin pass is what hid the last ai smoothness

- don't overcorrect. in round 2 i asked for unflattering: yawns, harsh light, food in mouth. it looked real but no brand would use it. aim for "attractive person on an ordinary day"

- fair and east asian skin comes out plastic by default. ask for texture by name

- in round 6, polished "brand" light made every shot look like an expensive camera. phone-video framing fixed it

- mirror selfies break physics. say "the whole photo is one reflection, back of the phone visible, no second mirror"

- gpt image blocks tight full body activewear. add a layer or frame from the waist up

- this is what worked in my tests, not a rule from openai

same creator in every shot

- make a 6-view sheet first (front, side and back, full body and close-up, plain grey background), then attach it to every new scene

- on a 5-frame mock ad the face, outfit and product label stayed the same in all 5

what not to do

- don't copy a real person's face from a photo. make fictional people only

- don't have the creator claim results ("this cleared my skin"). they demo, they don't testify

- don't post without the ai label. switch it on at upload

make it look like a frame someone paused, not a photo someone posed

reply with your niche and i'll send you the exact prompt i'd use for it

bookmark this and open it before your next batch

如何制作看起来不像 AI 的 AI UGC 创作者照片

我经过 7 轮测试生成了约 150 个虚拟创作者。到第 5 轮时，在手机屏幕尺寸下我已经分辨不出来了。第 7 轮才是我真正会用的版本

核心玩法：暂停的视频画面 -> 房间自身的光线 > 真实的皮肤 > 手机视频"破坏"处理

第一步

- 打开 https://t.co/tTladQiKyi 并开启一个新对话（内置 gpt image）

- 不要要求"一张照片"。要"一个有人为自己日常故事录制的竖屏手机视频中的暂停画面"

- 设定取景方式：前置摄像头伸臂距离，或把手机支在约一米远的地方。每张片子选其中一种

- 眼睛看着屏幕、略低于镜头位置，而不是直视镜头。这才是人们面对前置摄像头时真正的样子

- 描述房间自带的光线混合："灰色的窗光加上暖色顶灯"。不要金色时刻，不要"明亮通透"

- 把房间放进去：没铺好的床、一根充电线、一个马克杯、一个洗衣篮。像出租屋，而不是 pinterest

- 描述你想要的皮肤，而不是要避免什么：可见的毛孔、桃绒毛、几处斑点、额头和鼻子上微微的油光

- 加上小细节：偏白的牙齿、毛躁的碎发、几乎没有化妆

- 每张片子都要换表情和机位。第 1 轮中，10 张里有 7 张是同样的闭嘴坏笑

破坏处理（ruin pass）

- 第 1 到第 5 轮：缩小到 720p 再放大回来，加一点模糊和锐化，轻微颗粒感，保存为 jpg

- 第 7 轮（更好）：把图片转为 720p 的 1 秒视频，然后截取一帧。真实的视频压缩会涂抹皮肤、堵死阴影，就像暂停的 tiktok 那样。capcut 可以做到：导出 1 秒的 720p 视频，然后截图

注意事项

- 干净的图还是太干净了。正是"破坏处理"藏起了最后那一点 AI 般的平滑感

- 不要过度纠正。第 2 轮我要求的是"不好看的"：打哈欠、硬光、嘴里有食物。看着真实，但没有品牌会用。目标是"一个普通日子里很有吸引力的人"

- 白皙和东亚肤色默认会显得塑料感。要按名称点名要求纹理

- 第 6 轮时，精修的"品牌感"光线让每张片子都像昂贵相机拍的。手机视频式的取景解决了这个问题

- 镜面自拍会违背物理规律。要说明"整张照片就是一面反射，能看到手机背面，没有第二面镜子"

- gpt image 会拦截紧身全身运动装。加一层衣物，或者改成半身取景

- 这是我在测试中有效的做法，不是 openai 的官方规则

每张片子都用同一个创作者

- 先做一张六视图参考表（正面、侧面和背面、全身和特写、纯灰背景），然后把它附加到每一个新场景

- 在一个 5 帧的模拟广告中，脸、服装和产品标签在全部 5 帧里都保持一致

不要做的事

- 不要照着真人照片复制别人的脸。只做虚构人物

- 不要让创作者宣称效果（"这个治好了我的皮肤"）。他们是演示，不是作证

- 不要不带 AI 标签就发布。上传时把它打开

让它看起来像有人暂停的一帧画面，而不是有人摆拍的一张照片

Create an intimate macro photograph of the uploaded reference character as a tiny, living, real miniature sitting in the open palm of a human hand held out in the rain, sheltered under a single large green leaf tilted over its head like an umbrella while raindrops fall all around it. The feeling must be: the whole world is getting wet, and this small character is perfectly dry and content.

Likeness Integrity (CRITICAL)
Preserve the character exactly: proportions, eye shape and spacing, facial structure, silhouette, anatomy, colors, materials, clothing, accessories, and recognizable design language. Do not humanize, redesign, or add facial features or anatomy that are absent from the reference.
If the character has no visible nose or mouth, do NOT add them.
The calm look must come from posture and gaze direction only. Do not add eyelids, eyebrows, or new eye shapes. The eyes stay exactly as in the reference.
Scale translation only: the character becomes a real physical object about the size of a small toy, roughly 6 to 8 cm tall. Its design does not change.

The Hand
One open palm held outstretched toward the camera, the fingers loosely spread and slightly curled. Cropped at the wrist, entering from the bottom of the frame. Natural skin, neutral and plain, with realistic palm lines. Exactly five fingers, no rings, no nail polish, no tattoos, no jewelry.
The skin is wet and shiny, with scattered raindrops and one small shallow pool of water in a palm crease, showing ripples from falling drops.
No finger may cover the character's face or any key design detail.
The palm shows a gentle dent where the character's weight rests, with one soft contact shadow under it.

Pose & Action
The character sits upright or slightly leaning in the center of the palm, relaxed and secure, adapting to its real anatomy. Do not invent limbs or hands the reference does not have.
It holds the stem of one large, glossy green leaf with its own hands, or if its anatomy does not allow it, the leaf is propped tilted against its shoulder. The leaf arches over its head, leaving the face, eyes, and key design details clearly visible. The leaf is the only added item.
Rain beads along the leaf's surface and runs off its tip, with one drip frozen mid-fall in front of the character.
The character's body stays almost dry, with just a few tiny droplets on its lower edges and feet where splashes bounced up.
The head is tilted slightly up, gaze directed at the viewer, a calm, slightly amused look that says: it's raining, and I'm doing just fine.
Slight asymmetry in posture. Nothing stiff, no dramatic motion.

Vertical macro portrait, 100mm macro lens, camera slightly above and to the side of the palm at a gentle three-quarter angle.
Character slightly left of center, the palm filling the lower third, the leaf arching across the upper left.
Framing rule (CRITICAL): the entire character, the leaf, and the frozen drip must be fully visible. Nothing cropped, nothing hidden by fingers.

Depth of Field (MANDATORY)
Primary focus: the character's face, eyes, upper body, and the nearest edge of the leaf, razor sharp with crisp catchlights.
Torso and legs: clearly detailed but softly falling off.
Fingertips, wrist, far raindrops, and background: creamy blur.
No full-frame sharpness.

Lighting
Soft overcast daylight from above and behind, cool and silvery, wrapping a thin pale rim around the character and the leaf.
Backlight catches every raindrop as a bright, crisp point or fine streak, and the leaf glows with a soft translucent green where light passes through.
Gentle shadow falloff across the palm. Never harsh.
No flat lighting.

Atmosphere & Effects
Fine rain frozen mid-fall in sharp lines and points, a few close drops blurred large in front of the lens, subtle wet-air haze, and ripples spreading in the palm pool. Clean render with very fine grain.

Background & Color
Out-of-focus soft gray-green with dark foliage shapes, hazy sky glow, and a few round, gentle bokeh highlights. No identifiable objects.
Muted, cool rainy backdrop against warm skin tones, so the character's own colors and the leaf's single saturated green read clearly.

Material & Texture
Treat the character as a real, precisely made miniature object: faithful original materials, tiny believable surface details, soft specular highlights, and clean micro detail visible in the focus zone. Do not make it glossier, softer, or more plastic than the reference. The leaf shows real veins and waxy wet sheen.

Mood
Calm, cozy, quietly cheerful.

Constraints
No text, no logos, no additional props beyond the single leaf, no umbrella, no raincoat, no boots, no second character, no scale cues like coins or rulers, no heavy storm, no flooding, no flat lighting.

提示词 👇

创作一张亲密的微距照片：上传的参考角色化作一个微小的、活生生的真实微缩模型，坐在一只伸到雨中的、摊开的人类手掌里；它头顶斜撑着一片巨大的绿色叶子当作雨伞 shelters，头顶遮蔽，而雨点从四面八方落下。感觉必须是：整个世界都被淋湿了，而这个小小的角色完全干燥、满足。

相似度完整性（关键）
精确保留角色：比例、眼睛形状与间距、面部结构、轮廓、解剖结构、颜色、材质、服装、配饰以及可识别的设计语言。不要拟人化，不要重新设计，不要添加参考图中不存在的面部特征或解剖结构。
如果角色没有可见的鼻子或嘴，不要添加。
平静的神情只能来自姿势和视线方向。不要添加眼皮、眉毛或新的眼睛形状。眼睛必须与参考图完全一致。
仅做尺度转换：角色变成一个真实存在的小物件，大约小玩具大小，高约 6 至 8 厘米。其设计不做改变。

手部
一只摊开的手掌向镜头伸出，手指松散张开并略微弯曲。在手腕处裁切，从画面下方进入。自然的皮肤，中性朴素，带有真实的手掌纹路。恰好五根手指，无戒指、无指甲油、无纹身、无珠宝。
皮肤湿润发亮，散布着雨水珠，手掌纹褶处有一小片浅浅的积水，可见落下的水滴激起的涟漪。
任何手指都不得遮挡角色的面部或任何关键设计细节。
手掌在其重量所倚靠处呈现柔和的凹陷，下方有一层柔和的接触阴影。

姿势与动作
角色坐在掌心中央，坐直或略微倾斜，放松而安定，顺应其真实解剖结构。不要虚构参考图没有的四肢或手。
它用自己的手握住一片大而有光泽的绿色叶子的茎；如果其解剖结构不允许，则将叶子斜撑在其肩上。叶子在头顶弯成拱形，让面部、眼睛和关键设计细节清晰可见。叶子是唯一新增的物件。
雨水沿叶面聚成水珠并从叶尖流下，在角色前方有一滴被定格在半空中的水滴。
角色身体几乎保持干燥，仅在下缘和脚部有几点细小的水珠，那是溅起的水花。
头部微微上扬，视线朝向观者，神情平静、略带玩味，仿佛在说：下雨了，而我过得挺好。
姿势略有不对称。不僵硬，无剧烈动作。

相机与构图
竖幅微距肖像，100mm 微距镜头，相机位于手掌斜上方并偏向侧面，柔和的四分之三角度。
角色略偏画面中心左侧，手掌占满下三分之一，叶子在左上方横跨成拱。
构图规则（关键）：整个角色、叶子以及被定格的水滴都必须完整可见。不得裁切，不得被手指遮挡。

景深（强制）
主要焦点：角色的面部、眼睛、上半身以及叶子的最近边缘，锐利如刀，捕捉光点清晰。
躯干与腿部：细节清晰但柔和地渐次虚化。
指尖、手腕、远处雨滴与背景：奶油般的模糊。
不要整幅画面都锐利。

灯光
来自上方与后方的柔和阴天日光，冷调银灰，为角色与叶子包裹上一层淡淡的光边。
逆光让每一滴雨水呈现为明亮清晰的光点或细streak，叶子在光线透过处散发柔和的半透明绿光。
手掌上的阴影柔和过渡。绝不生硬。
不要平光。

氛围与效果
细雨在半空中被定格成清晰的线条与光点，镜头前方有几滴被放大的虚化水珠，隐约的湿空气薄雾，以及掌中水洼里扩散的涟漪。干净的渲染，带有极细的颗粒。

背景与色彩
失焦的柔和灰绿色，带有深色植物形状、朦胧的天空光辉，以及几个圆润柔和的散景光斑。无可识别的物件。
低饱和、冷调的雨天背景衬托温暖的肤色，使角色自身的颜色和叶子唯一的饱和绿清晰可辨。

材质与纹理
将角色当作一个真实、精密制作的微缩物件：忠实的原始材质、细微可信的表面细节、柔和的高光，以及在合焦区域内可见的干净微观细节。不要让它比参考图更光亮、更柔软或更具塑料感。叶子呈现真实的叶脉和蜡质湿润光泽。

情绪
平静、舒适、安静的愉悦。

限制
不要文字，不要 logo，不要除那片叶子以外的任何额外道具，不要伞，不要雨衣，不要靴子，不要第二个角色，不要硬币或尺子之类的尺度参照，不要暴风雨，不要洪水，不要平光。

UNIVERSAL LUXURY AUTOMOTIVE-INSPIRED PRODUCT DESIGN PROMPT

Create an ultra-realistic, premium coffee machine inspired by the design and silhouette of a luxury automobile. The concept should creatively transform the selected vehicle's distinctive exterior styling into a fully integrated, functional-looking countertop coffee maker.

1. AUTOMOTIVE DESIGN

Study the chosen vehicle's defining design elements, including its body shape, proportions, front grille, headlights, wheels, windows, and signature styling. Faithfully translate these features into the coffee machine while maintaining the recognizable identity of the vehicle. The result should look like a professionally engineered miniature automotive-inspired appliance, not simply a toy car.

2. TRANSPARENT COFFEE BEAN COMPARTMENT

Integrate an elegant, crystal-clear glass coffee bean container into the upper section or roof of the vehicle. Fill it with freshly roasted coffee beans, making their texture and rich brown colour clearly visible. Ensure the glass compartment looks naturally incorporated into the overall design.

3. COFFEE DISPENSING SYSTEM

Seamlessly integrate a realistic coffee dispenser into the front section of the vehicle. Show freshly brewed espresso flowing directly into a stylish coffee cup positioned underneath. Include delicate rising steam to create a warm, freshly brewed atmosphere.

4. ENVIRONMENT & COMPOSITION

Place the coffee machine on a sophisticated kitchen countertop. Create a warm, modern kitchen environment with softly blurred green indoor plants, tasteful decorations, and subtle lifestyle details. Keep the product as the central focal point.

5. PHOTOGRAPHY & LIGHTING

Use premium commercial product photography with photorealistic materials, refined reflections, realistic glass transparency, detailed automotive finishes, soft natural lighting, cinematic depth of field, and beautifully controlled shadows.

FINAL CREATIVE DIRECTION

The final image must look like an exclusive luxury designer appliance that combines automotive craftsmanship with modern coffee-making technology. Preserve the selected vehicle's recognizable design language while ensuring every coffee-making component is visually integrated and believable.

QUALITY REQUIREMENTS: Ultra-photorealistic, 8K detail, professional advertising photography, realistic proportions, premium industrial design, sharp product focus, no distorted components, no additional vehicles, no unnecessary text, and no watermark.

Customization: Replace the selected vehicle with any car, SUV, sports car, classic automobile, or other vehicle while adapting its signature design elements to the coffee machine.

通用奢华汽车灵感产品设计提示词

打造一台超逼真、高端的咖啡机，其设计灵感来自豪华汽车的造型与轮廓。该概念应创造性地将所选车辆独特的外饰风格转化为一台完全整合、外观具备功能感的台面咖啡机。

1. 汽车设计

研究所选车辆的定义性设计元素，包括车身造型、比例、前格栅、前大灯、轮毂、车窗以及标志性风格。在保持车辆可辨识身份特征的前提下，将这些特征忠实地转译到咖啡机上。成品应看起来像一台专业工程打造的汽车灵感迷你家电，而非仅仅是一辆玩具车。

2. 透明咖啡豆仓

将一个优雅、晶莹剔透的玻璃咖啡豆容器整合到车辆的上部区域或车顶之中。装满新鲜烘焙的咖啡豆，使其纹理和浓郁的棕色色泽清晰可见。确保该玻璃舱体看起来自然地融入整体设计之中。

3. 咖啡出液系统

将一个逼真的咖啡出口装置无缝整合到车辆前部区域。呈现新鲜萃取的浓缩咖啡直接流入下方一只时尚咖啡杯的画面。加入细腻升腾的蒸汽，营造温暖、刚冲煮完成的氛围。

4. 环境与构图

将咖啡机置于考究的厨房台面上。营造温暖、现代的厨房环境，包含柔和虚化的绿色室内植物、雅致的装饰以及细微的生活细节。保持产品为画面中的核心焦点。

5. 摄影与灯光

采用高端商业产品摄影风格，具备照片级真实的材质、精致的反射、真实的玻璃通透性、细致的汽车漆面质感、柔和的自然光、电影级景深以及控制优美的阴影。

最终创意方向

最终图像必须看起来像一件专属的奢华设计师家电，将汽车工艺与现代咖啡制作技术融为一体。在确保每一个咖啡制作部件都视觉上整合且可信的同时，保留所选车辆可辨识的设计语言。

质量要求：超照片级真实感，8K 细节，专业广告摄影，真实的比例，高端工业设计，锐利的产品对焦，无变形部件，无多余车辆，无不必要的文字，无水印。

定制说明：可将所选车辆替换为任何轿车、SUV、跑车、经典老爷车或其他车型，同时将其标志性设计元素适配到咖啡机上。
